description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/Relist. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the POST relist operation in existing published product/listing management. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the relist operation for existing published product/listing management. Input: [FromBody] rq: RelistRequest. Main fields: Id: int. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the relist operation. Search terms: searchproduct relist. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_searchproduct_relist
title: Post Searchproduct Relist
